name: Firecracker Fulu

source.title: Pathfinder Season of Ghosts Hardcover Compilation

text:
Activate F (concentrate)

Trigger You critically succeed at an attack roll with the affixed weapon.

---
The fulu explodes and showers the area with bright sparks. The struck creature takes an additional 1d4 sonic damage and must succeed at a DC 15 Fortitude save save or be Dazzled for 1 round (or dazzled for 1 minute on a critical failure).
